subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay separate for live Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket proof, or should maintainers fold it into the existing Control UI CSP/Zod issue after choosing the safe CSP repair direction?
rationale: The CSP portion overlaps an open security-sensitive canonical thread, but the reported proxy-specific WebSocket 1006 path could be a separate auth/origin/proxy failure and needs maintainer intent before automation changes CSP or gateway behavior.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Proxy Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the overlapping Zod/CSP repair stays on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Fold Into CSP Thread
options.body: Treat the WebSocket 1006 as likely startup fallout from the CSP failure and consolidate follow-up under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Sponsor CSP Fix First
options.body: Resolve the strict-CSP Zod jitless path first, then request fresh proxy proof only if the WebSocket failure remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Proxy Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the overlapping Zod/CSP repair stays on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history trail across Control UI CSP, origin hardening, and the gateway connect flow.
